name: HH App Connector
brief: API pages, a permission set and the AUTOPOST posting guard for the Homestead household app
description: Per-tenant connector for the Homestead household finance app: hhBankLedgerEntries (read), hhBudgetEntries (insert and read, non-ORIG budgets only), hhJournalLineChecks (read), hhJournalLines (insert and read in the HHAPP template, with dimensions over the account defaults), the HH-APP permission set, the source/reason code defaults for the HHAPP/AUTOPOST batch, and (since 1.0.0.4) the guard that lets API sessions post HHAPP/AUTOPOST only. Approved at Gate 1 (Phase 3 spec, Proposed Business Central changes 1-3 and 6).
